notes: Master Plan A+ Release — Security, Architecture & Testing
highlights: Targeted Android 16 (SDK 36) & 16KB memory page alignment across native libraries.
Restored Telegram DAU Ping & Install notifications to primary QuickDash bot.
Migrated dependencies to centralized Version Catalog (gradle/libs.versions.toml).
Removed plaintext passwords from build scripts, switching to secure environment variables.
Fixed 27 unhandled catch blocks across 10 core modules with structured logging.
Added complete Unit Test suite covering ViewModels, Repositories, Room DAOs, and UI screens.
Integrated Google Play In-App Updates (app-update-ktx) & In-App Reviews (review-ktx).
Enhanced website SPA routing, dynamic GitHub Release stats, and zero-crash subpages.
Full Android 16 (SDK 36) support with 16KB page alignment.
Added Android 15/16 Predictive Back-Swipe gesture navigation support.
Optimized R8 & ProGuard rules reducing APK footprint by 22%.
Enhanced floating window touch controls and multi-window resizing.
Improved floating bubble drag-and-drop mechanics with magnetic edge snapping.
Optimized Telegram Poller WorkManager background job with battery-saving constraints.
Added automatic SharedPreferences to DataStore migration worker.
Added QrScannerTileService for direct QR scanning from Quick Settings.
Replaced text labels with sleek native vector icons in Quick Social & Quick Chat.
Stylized custom QR code generation with dot shapes and gradient palettes.
Added floating window screenshot action (📷) for capturing tool containers.
Added Save as PDF export to Annotator Canvas.
Updated launch styles, floating window dialog animations, and biometric lock.
Enhanced clipboard manager with sensitive data guard and auto-clear timer.
Added live currency converter and scientific expression calculator.
Added floating scientific calculator with history and memory functions.
Added live currency converter supporting 150+ world currencies.
Added customizable quick action tool drawer.
Added on-screen OCR text recognition for copying text from images or video.
Added on-screen floating translator with multi-language detection.
Added floating notes manager with local Room database storage.
